info.title: SWAFTO Retail Desk API
info.description: Generated by tools/gen-openapi.mjs from the Fastify route schemas. Do not edit. The shop is always taken from the session, never from the request (S-11). Errors carry a short code and a request id; never a stack, SQL or constraint name.

get.summary: Web account-deletion page (HTML), required by Google Play.
Readiness. 503 while the database does not answer or while shutting down.
Operational alerts. A figure with nothing behind it is null, not zero.

post.summary: Sign a device out. Only a device of the same shop may be revoked; any other id is a 404.

404.description: Not found. not_found (also for another shop's device: no oracle)

post.summary: Send a sign-in code by SMS. The answer is identical whether or not the number has an account.

202.description: Accepted. Nothing in the body says whether an SMS went out.

post.summary: Exchange a code for a session. A first sign-in must carry consent; no account exists without it.

refreshToken.description: Single-use: the refresh endpoint returns its successor.

403.description: Refused. consent_required: a first sign-in without an affirmative consent

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token. Each refresh token works once; presenting a spent one revokes the device (RT-10).

refreshToken.description: The successor. The client must store it and send it next time.

401.description: Unauthenticated. unauthenticated (bad, expired or wrong-type token) or device_revoked (revoked device, or a spent refresh token was replayed)

get.summary: The shop's plan and what the phone needs to start a purchase.

503.description: Unavailable. billing_not_configured (Retry-After is not set: the cause is configuration)

post.summary: Google Play real-time developer notification (Pub/Sub push). Authenticated by Google's signed OIDC token, not a session. Always acknowledged with 204 once authenticated.

204.description: Acknowledged. The notification body is not trusted; Google is asked.

401.description: Unauthenticated. not a push this server accepts (the OIDC token did not verify)

post.summary: Bind a Google Play purchase to this shop after asking Google about it.

400.description: Validation failed: an unknown, missing or malformed field. wrong_product or purchase_not_found

502.description: Upstream unavailable. play_unreachable: Google could not be asked; retry

post.summary: Close a day with the counted cash. Closing again with the same count is a no-op; a different count is 409.

409.description: Conflict. the day is already closed with a different count

422.description: Unprocessable. the close was refused (see body)

get.summary: The day close as figures, with the working of the cash check.

400.description: Validation failed: an unknown, missing or malformed field. invalid_date

post.summary: Web deletion path: confirm with the code and request erasure. Public.
Web deletion path: send a code to the registered number. Public.

get.summary: The shop's devices, revoked ones included.
The itemised privacy notice (DPDP). Public: it is read before an account exists.

post.summary: Grant or withdraw one purpose. Withdrawing account_and_ledger is deletion, and answers 409 saying so.

get.summary: The consent log and the current state of each purpose.

post.summary: Request erasure. Nothing is deleted until the grace period ends.

get.summary: Everything held about the user, as one JSON document (DPDP access).
The named grievance officer and the response time.

404.description: Not found. not_found (unknown or erased shop)

400.description: Validation failed: an unknown, missing or malformed field. invalid_date

get.summary: Everything held about one party (DPDP access for the shopkeeper's customer).

404.description: Not found. not_found (also for another shop's party)

post.summary: Erase a party's name and phone; the ledger entries stay.

404.description: Not found. not_found (also for another shop's party)

get.summary: The reports screen's figures for a date range.

400.description: Validation failed: an unknown, missing or malformed field. invalid_date, invalid_range or range_too_long

post.summary: Push the phone outbox. Idempotent by id; per-row rejections are reported in the body, not as an HTTP error.

bearerAuth.description: The accessToken from /v1/auth/otp/verify or /v1/auth/refresh. A revoked device is refused even with a token in date.

googleOidc.description: Google's signed OIDC token on a Pub/Sub push; audience, issuer and service-account email are verified.

BadRequest.description: Validation failed: an unknown, missing or malformed field. Unknown fields are refused, not stripped.

Unauthenticated.description: No valid session: error is unauthenticated, or device_revoked for a signed-out device.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body is over the limit.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Retry-After is a real number of seconds and always reaches zero.

Unavailable.description: The database is down, saturated or timing out: try again. The phone keeps its outbox.
